name: experiment-paper-grill
description: Journal-calibrated scientific review of experiments, manuscript claims, and formulas, one question at a time.

interface.shortDescription: Scientific questioning calibrated to your target journal.
interface.longDescription: Review the scientific understanding behind experiments, manuscript claims, and formulas. Research the target journal first, calibrate interdisciplinary depth, inspect supplied evidence, and ask one question at a time with a concise answer direction.
defaultPrompt: 我的目标期刊是 Nature Communications。先调研期刊，再根据我上传的论文和实验材料，一次只问一个科学问题。
Review my formula and manuscript context. First establish the target venue, then question my scientific understanding one question at a time.
